releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with ownership import performance and provenance fixes from #358 and #361. Join-ShareSurferOwnershipSources aggregates OBS-only project/path/group context by OBS bucket, applies that context once per matching strong identity row, and keeps provenance merging set-backed while the import is running instead of repeatedly splitting and rejoining large delimited strings. This addresses the large-context CSV path observed in a 150,003-row source that was still crawling after roughly 40 hours, fixes context-before-identity duplicate provenance, prevents row-scoped NoJoinKey warnings from being stamped onto strong identity rows, adds a no-key source guardrail, and keeps the previous prerelease progress output plus OBS context application/orphan counters. Operators with older long-running context imports should stop that run and rerun on this optimized release. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
